All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.
Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

data.descriptionPlain:
Who is Sonar?
Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.
Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.
We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:
SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.
Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:
Committed to our customers and community.
Obsessed with quality.
Deliberate in our decisions.
Effective as one team.
With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.
Position description
Account-based marketing is at the center of how Sonar wins and expands its most strategic enterprise accounts, and we are investing to scale it. Based in one of our hubs in Austin, London, or Geneva and part of the Demand Generation squad, the ABM Manager owns the strategy, execution, and measurement of one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many programs that engage our highest-value target and customer accounts. You will orchestrate personalized, multi-channel campaigns that align marketing and sales around a shared list of accounts, accelerate pipeline, and deepen expansion within the enterprises that rely on Sonar.
This is a full-funnel, hands-on role that blends strategic account selection with day-to-day campaign execution. You will partner closely with sales, SDR, field, demand generation, and product marketing teams to build account plans, deploy the right plays at the right stage, and prove impact with rigorous measurement. Success requires equal parts strategic thinking, creative campaign building, strong analytics, and the relationship skills to keep marketing and sales moving as one team against a common set of accounts.

Position description

Account-based marketing is at the center of how Sonar wins and expands its most strategic enterprise accounts, and we are investing to scale it. Based in one of our hubs in Austin, London, or Geneva and part of the Demand Generation squad, the ABM Manager owns the strategy, execution, and measurement of one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many programs that engage our highest-value target and customer accounts. You will orchestrate personalized, multi-channel campaigns that align marketing and sales around a shared list of accounts, accelerate pipeline, and deepen expansion within the enterprises that rely on Sonar.

This is a full-funnel, hands-on role that blends strategic account selection with day-to-day campaign execution. You will partner closely with sales, SDR, field, demand generation, and product marketing teams to build account plans, deploy the right plays at the right stage, and prove impact with rigorous measurement. Success requires equal parts strategic thinking, creative campaign building, strong analytics, and the relationship skills to keep marketing and sales moving as one team against a common set of accounts.

lists.content:
• Own ABM strategy and account selection: Define and run Sonar’s account-based marketing strategy across one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many tiers — partnering with sales to select, segment, and prioritize target and expansion accounts based on fit, intent, and opportunity.

  • Build and execute multi-channel account plays: Plan, build, and continuously optimize personalized campaigns across paid (e.g., LinkedIn, display, and ABM platforms such as 6sense or Demandbase), email, web personalization, direct mail, and content — tailored to each account’s buying stage and stakeholders.

  • Align marketing and sales: Serve as the connective tissue between marketing and the account teams — co-developing account plans with AEs and SDRs, equipping them with the right messaging and assets, and coordinating outbound and marketing touches into a single, orchestrated motion.

  • Define and optimize the ICP: Partner with product marketing and sales to define, refine, and continuously optimize Sonar’s ideal customer profile — using performance data, intent signals, and win/loss insight to sharpen account selection and targeting.

  • Leverage intent and engagement data: Use intent signals, engagement scoring, and account analytics to identify in-market accounts, prioritize outreach, and trigger the right plays at the right moment.

  • Drive pipeline and expansion: Generate and accelerate qualified pipeline within target accounts and expansion within existing customers — tracking engagement, opportunity creation, and influenced pipeline against clear goals.

  • Measure and report on impact: Define and own ABM metrics — account engagement, pipeline contribution, velocity, and ROI — and deliver regular reporting with clear, data-driven recommendations to refine targeting and spend.

  • Partner cross-functionally on content and messaging: Work with product marketing and content teams to develop account- and persona-specific messaging, assets, and experiences that resonate with technical and executive buyers.

  • Collaborate on field and event programs: Partner with field and demand gen teammates to integrate ABM into events, executive roundtables, and webinars that engage priority accounts and convert into pipeline.

  • Manage budget and vendors: Allocate and steward the ABM budget for maximum return, and manage ABM platform, data, and agency vendors to ensure quality execution.

• Have 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a focus on account-based marketing, demand generation, or integrated campaigns — preferably within enterprise SaaS or technology.

  • Bring a proven track record of planning and executing ABM programs (one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many) that engage target accounts and drive measurable pipeline and expansion.

  • Have hands-on experience with ABM and intent platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks) and an understanding of how to operationalize account data and intent signals.

  • Have strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, optimize spend, track account engagement and pipeline, and report on ROI across channels.

  • Be experienced partnering closely with sales and SDR teams to align on account strategy, plays, and follow-up.

  • Be proficient with marketing automation tools and CRM systems (e.g., Marketing Cloud, Salesforce).

  • Be familiar with paid media and digital channels relevant to ABM, including LinkedIn and programmatic display.

  • Be highly organized and able to manage and prioritize multiple programs, accounts, and stakeholders simultaneously and independently.

  • Have exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to collaborate across departments and functions.

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (MBA a plus).

data.descriptionPlain:
Who is Sonar?
Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.
Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.
We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:
SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.
Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:
Committed to our customers and community.
Obsessed with quality.
Deliberate in our decisions.
Effective as one team.
With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.
Position description
Account-based marketing is at the center of how Sonar wins and expands its most strategic enterprise accounts, and we are investing to scale it. Based in one of our hubs in Austin, London, or Geneva and part of the Demand Generation squad, the ABM Manager owns the strategy, execution, and measurement of one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many programs that engage our highest-value target and customer accounts. You will orchestrate personalized, multi-channel campaigns that align marketing and sales around a shared list of accounts, accelerate pipeline, and deepen expansion within the enterprises that rely on Sonar.
This is a full-funnel, hands-on role that blends strategic account selection with day-to-day campaign execution. You will partner closely with sales, SDR, field, demand generation, and product marketing teams to build account plans, deploy the right plays at the right stage, and prove impact with rigorous measurement. Success requires equal parts strategic thinking, creative campaign building, strong analytics, and the relationship skills to keep marketing and sales moving as one team against a common set of accounts.

Position description

Account-based marketing is at the center of how Sonar wins and expands its most strategic enterprise accounts, and we are investing to scale it. Based in one of our hubs in Austin, London, or Geneva and part of the Demand Generation squad, the ABM Manager owns the strategy, execution, and measurement of one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many programs that engage our highest-value target and customer accounts. You will orchestrate personalized, multi-channel campaigns that align marketing and sales around a shared list of accounts, accelerate pipeline, and deepen expansion within the enterprises that rely on Sonar.

This is a full-funnel, hands-on role that blends strategic account selection with day-to-day campaign execution. You will partner closely with sales, SDR, field, demand generation, and product marketing teams to build account plans, deploy the right plays at the right stage, and prove impact with rigorous measurement. Success requires equal parts strategic thinking, creative campaign building, strong analytics, and the relationship skills to keep marketing and sales moving as one team against a common set of accounts.

lists.content:
• Own ABM strategy and account selection: Define and run Sonar’s account-based marketing strategy across one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many tiers — partnering with sales to select, segment, and prioritize target and expansion accounts based on fit, intent, and opportunity.

  • Build and execute multi-channel account plays: Plan, build, and continuously optimize personalized campaigns across paid (e.g., LinkedIn, display, and ABM platforms such as 6sense or Demandbase), email, web personalization, direct mail, and content — tailored to each account’s buying stage and stakeholders.

  • Align marketing and sales: Serve as the connective tissue between marketing and the account teams — co-developing account plans with AEs and SDRs, equipping them with the right messaging and assets, and coordinating outbound and marketing touches into a single, orchestrated motion.

  • Define and optimize the ICP: Partner with product marketing and sales to define, refine, and continuously optimize Sonar’s ideal customer profile — using performance data, intent signals, and win/loss insight to sharpen account selection and targeting.

  • Leverage intent and engagement data: Use intent signals, engagement scoring, and account analytics to identify in-market accounts, prioritize outreach, and trigger the right plays at the right moment.

  • Drive pipeline and expansion: Generate and accelerate qualified pipeline within target accounts and expansion within existing customers — tracking engagement, opportunity creation, and influenced pipeline against clear goals.

  • Measure and report on impact: Define and own ABM metrics — account engagement, pipeline contribution, velocity, and ROI — and deliver regular reporting with clear, data-driven recommendations to refine targeting and spend.

  • Partner cross-functionally on content and messaging: Work with product marketing and content teams to develop account- and persona-specific messaging, assets, and experiences that resonate with technical and executive buyers.

  • Collaborate on field and event programs: Partner with field and demand gen teammates to integrate ABM into events, executive roundtables, and webinars that engage priority accounts and convert into pipeline.

  • Manage budget and vendors: Allocate and steward the ABM budget for maximum return, and manage ABM platform, data, and agency vendors to ensure quality execution.

• Have 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a focus on account-based marketing, demand generation, or integrated campaigns — preferably within enterprise SaaS or technology.

  • Bring a proven track record of planning and executing ABM programs (one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many) that engage target accounts and drive measurable pipeline and expansion.

  • Have hands-on experience with ABM and intent platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks) and an understanding of how to operationalize account data and intent signals.

  • Have strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, optimize spend, track account engagement and pipeline, and report on ROI across channels.

  • Be experienced partnering closely with sales and SDR teams to align on account strategy, plays, and follow-up.

  • Be proficient with marketing automation tools and CRM systems (e.g., Marketing Cloud, Salesforce).

  • Be familiar with paid media and digital channels relevant to ABM, including LinkedIn and programmatic display.

  • Be highly organized and able to manage and prioritize multiple programs, accounts, and stakeholders simultaneously and independently.

  • Have exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to collaborate across departments and functions.

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (MBA a plus).

Gitar.ai is an AI-native code review platform that uses AI agents to support pull request validation and CI workflows by reviewing code, diagnosing failures, proposing fixes, and adding tests and validations directly within existing development processes. Gitar automatically makes every change production-ready, approves and merges routine changes, involves humans only in exception cases, and learns from each exception to improve over time. In that model, humans oversee the end-to-end process rather than manually reviewing every change. 
What you will do
You will be one of the founding members of the Gitar.ai go-to-market team. You will be responsible for Gitar.ai inbound and outbound sales, building pipeline, running evaluations and proofs-of-concept, and closing deals with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and Heads of Platform Engineering.  
This is a full-cycle, high-velocity role inside a category-defining platform. You will own the entire sales cycle, bringing deep technical understanding and business value orientation to potential customers. You’ll also play a critical role in building our go-to-market team and capabilities from the ground up, working directly with the founders of Gitar.ai and the broader Sonar marketing, sales, and customer success teams.

lists.content:
• Own the entire revenue cycle for standalone AI code review deals: prospecting, technical discovery, multi-threaded developer and executive engagement, proof-of-value management, commercial negotiation, and close.

  • Focus on identifying prospective customers within our target ICPs, execute outbound campaigns , and build sales demand with the goal of driving closed-won business and customer success.

  • Become a product expert in both Gitar.ai and the broader Sonar product portfolio, so that you can manage the entire sales cycle including product demos and proofs of concept.

  • Continuously build pipeline while progressing active customer engagements and providing input to product teams as they deliver their roadmap. 

  • Maintain rigorous sales process hygiene, leveraging our sales methodologies, including Command of the Message and MEDDPICC, and our GTM tooling including Clari, Outreach, and Salesforce, to deliver high velocity sales cycles with enthusiastic customers.

The ideal candidate will

  • Have 5+ years of full-cycle, quota-carrying SaaS sales experience, including 3+ years selling technical products to IT, DevOps, platform engineering, or security buyers.
  • Demonstrate a track record of consistent overperformance against quota.
  • Possess technical competency to be able to learn Gitar.ai and Sonar’s software solutions and engage with technical buyers as well as executive stakeholders. This should include having a strong familiarity with modern software development — Git, CI/CD, code review workflows, SDLC tooling.
  • Have high levels of customer empathy and a passion for customer success.
  • Be energized about working in a startup environment, with a strong work ethic, embrace of ambiguity, and enthusiasm for constant learning and development. 
  • Be based in the San Francisco Bay Area and excited to work out in person with the team in our San Mateo office.

Gitar.ai is an AI-native code review platform that uses AI agents to support pull request validation and CI workflows by reviewing code, diagnosing failures, proposing fixes, and adding tests and validations directly within existing development processes. Gitar automatically makes every change production-ready, approves and merges routine changes, involves humans only in exception cases, and learns from each exception to improve over time. In that model, humans oversee the end-to-end process rather than manually reviewing every change.
 
Position description
Sonar is looking for a Product Manager to drive the roadmap for Gitar, our recently-acquired agentic code review platform. You will work hands-on, from San Mateo, with the Gitar founding team and the broader engineering organization to grow Gitar from a standalone product into a core part of Sonar's verification platform.
 
As a Product Manager, you will shape how Gitar evolves and how it integrates with the rest of the Sonar family. To achieve this, we need a passionate Product Manager who will research, clarify, and prioritize the needs of developers and engineering leaders evaluating agentic code review, translate a fast-moving competitive landscape into clear positioning, and turn those needs into a roadmap for the Gitar and Sonar teams.
 
You will join the Product Management team, composed of other passionate Product Managers eager to collaborate with you. You will also work closely with the Gitar engineering team and founders, and with Sonar's broader sales, marketing, and customer success teams, to make sure Gitar's roadmap reflects both what customers need today and where the combined SonarQube + Gitar experience is going.
 
By joining us, you will bring your experience shipping developer tools or AI-native products, your comfort operating in ambiguity, and your experience as a Product Manager to help take Gitar from a fast-growing standalone product to a core part of how the world reviews AI-generated code.

lists.content:
• Contribute to the different areas of the agentic code review vision and communicate about them, internally and externally.

  • Research, clarify, and prioritize opportunities to build and maintain an effective roadmap for Gitar in close partnership with the Gitar founding team.

  • Interact directly with our users and customers to support them, integrate their feedback, and identify opportunities.

  • Ensure Gitar continues to meet enterprise trust requirements customers expect (e.g., self-hosted deployment, SOC 2, and data residency).

  • Develop a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and translate it into clear product differentiation and positioning.

  • Work closely with other product managers to design cross-product features.

  • Partner with sales, marketing, and customer success to support deals, objection handling, and enablement content as Gitar scales inside Sonar's go-to-market motion.

  • Help the Product Management team grow in its organization, tools, and processes.

  • Attend conferences and give talks if you like.

• Passionate about AI-native developer tools and the shift toward agentic software development.

  • Experience in software product management, ideally for developer tools, DevOps, CI/CD, or code review/quality product.

  • Technical fluency with SDLC tooling — Git, CI/CD pipelines, pull request workflows, and source-control platforms (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps).

  • Familiar with the AI technologies powering coding agents - LLMs, agent harnesses, and how they plan, call tools, and take action inside a developer's workflow.

  • Understanding of AI/LLM-based products, including the trust, safety, and data-handling considerations enterprise buyers care about.

  • Highly autonomous and pragmatic, with an obsession for solving external customer problems; comfortable partnering directly with founders and a small, fast-moving team.

  • Excellent cross-functional collaborator, able to align product, engineering, sales, and marketing around a shared roadmap.

  • Open-minded and very positive can-do attitude.

  • Comfortable in dealing with change, complexity, and uncertainty, and operating with the speed and ambiguity of an early-stage, recently-acquired product.

  • Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo as well as to receive feedback.

  • Leadership: you take initiative and demonstrate your ability to lead a subject from beginning to end.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $175,000 – $250,000 USD+ other benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

lists.content:
• Spend the majority of your time (roughly 70%) designing, building, and iterating on agentic tooling: orchestration, tool-use, context management, and evaluation harnesses for autonomous code-modification agents.

  • Build and refine the verification layer that gates what agents are allowed to ship — automated test generation, regression detection, static analysis (using our own SonarQube), and human-in-the-loop checkpoints where warranted.

  • Spend the remainder of your time (roughly 30%) hands-on in our Java/Spring codebase: reviewing agent-generated pull requests, fixing what they get wrong, and feeding those lessons back into the tooling.

  • Partner closely with the Server, Cloud Platform, and value-stream squads whose domains you're migrating — earning their trust and buy-in matters as much as the code itself.

  • Experience influencing engineers and squads you don't manage — the migrations you'll enable depend on their trust as much as on your code.

  • Pension Scheme:2nd Pillar (bAV): Voluntary, 15% contribution by Sonar from social security savings.
  • We encourage usage of our robust time-off allocations with 28 PTO days plus additional days based on seniority and circumstances.
  • Sonar recognizes holidays on working calendar days. If the holiday date occurs on a Saturday, we will recognize the day on the preceding Friday. If the holiday date occurs on a Sunday, we will recognize the day on the following Monday.
  • Public transport reimbursement of 60% for annual subscription.
  • Generous discretionary Company Growth Bonus, paid annually.  
  • Global workforce with employees in 20+ countries representing 35+ unique nationalities.

lists.content:
• Outcome Driven Development: Work in a team developing and implementing advanced products that enable customers to post-train models to power their agentic coding practices.   These agents need to generate high-quality code that meets their enterprise standards and software development best practices.

  • Translate Prototypes to Products: Collaborate closely with researchers, research engineers, MLOps and engineers within the team to design hypotheses and experiments, iterate proofs-of-concept quickly and develop successful prototypes into cutting-edge products.

  • Subject Matter Expert: You will contribute and discuss ideas within our cross-disciplinary team, driving towards the next generation of coding model post-training for enterprises.

  • Spearhead Research & Innovation: Stay up-to-date with the latest LLM and agentic developments; you are driven by learning and teaching others. You will need to explain complex technical details and concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

The ideal candidate will have: 

  • An advanced academic background (Master’s or PhD) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.

  • 4+ years industry experience in machine learning, with a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices and tools.

  • Fluency with Python including core ML frameworks, experience with Rust or any of SonarQube’s flagship languages (C#, C++, JS/TS, Java) is a plus.  

  • Expertise in post-training of large language models, including:

  • Policy optimization algorithms (e.g. GRPO, PPO)

  • Verifier-based RL frameworks (RLVR)

  • Supervised fine-tuning (SFT)

  • Data-centric AI methods, including synthetic data and curation

  • Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT)

  • Preference and Safety Alignment

  • Experience of driving research projects, delivering valuable findings and prototypes, and then converting them into products. 

  • Excellent communication skills in English and a talent for explaining complex scientific topics clearly and concisely.

lists.content:
You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations.

You bring proven, multi-year experience in:

  • AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. You prototype on the frontier, then harden what works into reliable, governed production systems that internal teams depend on daily.

  • ITSM Platform Ownership (JSM): Administering, configuring, and continuously evolving Jira Service Management — including service catalog design, SLA management, queue configuration, request type rationalization, and automated routing. You treat JSM as a product, not a ticket system.

  • Atlassian Suite Administration: Managing the full Atlassian Cloud ecosystem (Jira Software, Confluence, JSM, Guard, Loom, Trello, Bitbucket) with deep expertise in governance, user access management, project templates, and platform health monitoring.

  • Automation Engineering: Designing and implementing sophisticated workflow automations — using Atlassian Automation, REST APIs, and third-party middleware — that eliminate manual processes and scale operations without adding headcount.

  • Enterprise Integration Architecture: Building and maintaining integrations between Atlassian and adjacent enterprise systems (Slack, HR platforms, identity providers, monitoring tools) using webhooks, APIs, and marketplace apps.

  • CMDB & Asset Management: Owning JSM Assets configuration, data integrity, and lifecycle management across IT hardware, software licenses, and configuration items (CIs) — ensuring a reliable, audit-ready source of truth.

  • ITSM Process Governance: Defining and enforcing ITIL-aligned processes including incident management, change management, problem management, and access management — translating business needs into governed, automated workflows.

  • Security, Compliance & Audit Support: Ensuring platform configurations adhere to SonarSource's data protection, access control, and audit requirements. Supporting external audit engagements (KPMG, PwC) with documentation and evidence packages.

  • Stakeholder Enablement: Partnering with all internal teams (HR, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, GTM) to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and deliver continuous improvements — acting as a true internal platform consultant.

  • Platform Roadmap Contribution: Proactively identifying opportunities to modernize internal processes, adopt new platform capabilities, and drive the platform roadmap forward in partnership with the BizTech BackOffice lead

Experience & Technical Acumen

  • AI Engineering (Required): Hands-on experience with AI-native platforms and building on them — Claude/Anthropic, MCP, agent frameworks (Rovo or equivalent), connectors, and prompt-based workflows. You've built and shipped something real, not just experimented.

  • Atlassian Platform Expertise (Required): 5+ years hands-on administration of Jira Service Management (JSM), Jira Software, and Confluence Cloud in enterprise, multi-team environments. Deep knowledge of JSM request types, workflows, SLAs, queues, automations, and service catalog design.

  • Automation & Integration Engineering: Proven experience building workflow automations using Atlassian Automation and/or third-party tools. Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON for system integrations. Scripting experience (Python, Groovy, JavaScript) is a strong plus.

  • Enterprise Tool Breadth: Experience with adjacent enterprise systems — identity providers (Okta, JumpCloud), collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom), or business systems (NetSuite, BambooHR, Salesforce) — is a strong differentiator. We don't need deep expertise in all of them, but curiosity and adaptability across the stack matters.

  • CMDB / Asset Management: Experience configuring and maintaining a CMDB or IT asset management system (JSM Assets, ServiceNow CMDB, or equivalent).

data.descriptionBody:
Position description

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance.

This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several.

While Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian suite form a core part of your platform footprint, your scope extends well beyond it: you will build and maintain integrations across our enterprise tool stack, engineer automation pipelines that eliminate manual work at scale, and operationalize AI-native capabilities (Enterprise Apps connectors, Claude MCP integrations, Rovo agents) that put Sonar ahead of the curve in AI-driven internal operations.

Your success will directly enable every internal team at Sonar to work faster, smarter, and with less friction — and will give leadership real-time visibility, consistent governance, and a platform that scales effortlessly with the company's global growth.

lists.content:
You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations.

You bring proven, multi-year experience in:

  • AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. You prototype on the frontier, then harden what works into reliable, governed production systems that internal teams depend on daily.

  • ITSM Platform Ownership (JSM): Administering, configuring, and continuously evolving Jira Service Management — including service catalog design, SLA management, queue configuration, request type rationalization, and automated routing. You treat JSM as a product, not a ticket system.

  • Atlassian Suite Administration: Managing the full Atlassian Cloud ecosystem (Jira Software, Confluence, JSM, Guard, Loom, Trello, Bitbucket) with deep expertise in governance, user access management, project templates, and platform health monitoring.

  • Automation Engineering: Designing and implementing sophisticated workflow automations — using Atlassian Automation, REST APIs, and third-party middleware — that eliminate manual processes and scale operations without adding headcount.

  • Enterprise Integration Architecture: Building and maintaining integrations between Atlassian and adjacent enterprise systems (Slack, HR platforms, identity providers, monitoring tools) using webhooks, APIs, and marketplace apps.

  • CMDB & Asset Management: Owning JSM Assets configuration, data integrity, and lifecycle management across IT hardware, software licenses, and configuration items (CIs) — ensuring a reliable, audit-ready source of truth.

  • ITSM Process Governance: Defining and enforcing ITIL-aligned processes including incident management, change management, problem management, and access management — translating business needs into governed, automated workflows.

  • Security, Compliance & Audit Support: Ensuring platform configurations adhere to SonarSource's data protection, access control, and audit requirements. Supporting external audit engagements (KPMG, PwC) with documentation and evidence packages.

  • Stakeholder Enablement: Partnering with all internal teams (HR, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, GTM) to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and deliver continuous improvements — acting as a true internal platform consultant.

  • Platform Roadmap Contribution: Proactively identifying opportunities to modernize internal processes, adopt new platform capabilities, and drive the platform roadmap forward in partnership with the BizTech BackOffice lead

  • AI Engineering (Required): Hands-on experience with AI-native platforms and building on them — Claude/Anthropic, MCP, agent frameworks (Rovo or equivalent), connectors, and prompt-based workflows. You've built and shipped something real, not just experimented.

  • Atlassian Platform Expertise (Required): 5+ years hands-on administration of Jira Service Management (JSM), Jira Software, and Confluence Cloud in enterprise, multi-team environments. Deep knowledge of JSM request types, workflows, SLAs, queues, automations, and service catalog design.

  • Automation & Integration Engineering: Proven experience building workflow automations using Atlassian Automation and/or third-party tools. Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON for system integrations. Scripting experience (Python, Groovy, JavaScript) is a strong plus.

  • Enterprise Tool Breadth: Experience with adjacent enterprise systems — identity providers (Okta, JumpCloud), collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom), or business systems (NetSuite, BambooHR, Salesforce) — is a strong differentiator. We don't need deep expertise in all of them, but curiosity and adaptability across the stack matters.

  • CMDB / Asset Management: Experience configuring and maintaining a CMDB or IT asset management system (JSM Assets, ServiceNow CMDB, or equivalent).

  • ITSM & ITIL Knowledge: Strong understanding of ITSM processes and ITIL v3/v4 frameworks — including incident, change, problem, and request management — with the ability to configure platform workflows that enforce these processes at scale.

Position description

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance.

This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several.

While Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian suite form a core part of your platform footprint, your scope extends well beyond it: you will build and maintain integrations across our enterprise tool stack, engineer automation pipelines that eliminate manual work at scale, and operationalize AI-native capabilities (Enterprise Apps connectors, Claude MCP integrations, Rovo agents) that put Sonar ahead of the curve in AI-driven internal operations.

Your success will directly enable every internal team at Sonar to work faster, smarter, and with less friction — and will give leadership real-time visibility, consistent governance, and a platform that scales effortlessly with the company's global growth.

lists.content:
You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations.

You bring proven, multi-year experience in:

  • AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. You prototype on the frontier, then harden what works into reliable, governed production systems that internal teams depend on daily.

  • ITSM Platform Ownership (JSM): Administering, configuring, and continuously evolving Jira Service Management — including service catalog design, SLA management, queue configuration, request type rationalization, and automated routing. You treat JSM as a product, not a ticket system.

  • Atlassian Suite Administration: Managing the full Atlassian Cloud ecosystem (Jira Software, Confluence, JSM, Guard, Loom, Trello, Bitbucket) with deep expertise in governance, user access management, project templates, and platform health monitoring.

  • Automation Engineering: Designing and implementing sophisticated workflow automations — using Atlassian Automation, REST APIs, and third-party middleware — that eliminate manual processes and scale operations without adding headcount.

  • Enterprise Integration Architecture: Building and maintaining integrations between Atlassian and adjacent enterprise systems (Slack, HR platforms, identity providers, monitoring tools) using webhooks, APIs, and marketplace apps.

  • CMDB & Asset Management: Owning JSM Assets configuration, data integrity, and lifecycle management across IT hardware, software licenses, and configuration items (CIs) — ensuring a reliable, audit-ready source of truth.

  • ITSM Process Governance: Defining and enforcing ITIL-aligned processes including incident management, change management, problem management, and access management — translating business needs into governed, automated workflows.

  • Security, Compliance & Audit Support: Ensuring platform configurations adhere to SonarSource's data protection, access control, and audit requirements. Supporting external audit engagements (KPMG, PwC) with documentation and evidence packages.

  • Stakeholder Enablement: Partnering with all internal teams (HR, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, GTM) to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and deliver continuous improvements — acting as a true internal platform consultant.

  • Platform Roadmap Contribution: Proactively identifying opportunities to modernize internal processes, adopt new platform capabilities, and drive the platform roadmap forward in partnership with the BizTech BackOffice lead

Experience & Technical Acumen

  • AI Engineering (Required): Hands-on experience with AI-native platforms and building on them — Claude/Anthropic, MCP, agent frameworks (Rovo or equivalent), connectors, and prompt-based workflows. You've built and shipped something real, not just experimented.

  • Atlassian Platform Expertise (Required): 5+ years hands-on administration of Jira Service Management (JSM), Jira Software, and Confluence Cloud in enterprise, multi-team environments. Deep knowledge of JSM request types, workflows, SLAs, queues, automations, and service catalog design.

  • Automation & Integration Engineering: Proven experience building workflow automations using Atlassian Automation and/or third-party tools. Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON for system integrations. Scripting experience (Python, Groovy, JavaScript) is a strong plus.

  • Enterprise Tool Breadth: Experience with adjacent enterprise systems — identity providers (Okta, JumpCloud), collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom), or business systems (NetSuite, BambooHR, Salesforce) — is a strong differentiator. We don't need deep expertise in all of them, but curiosity and adaptability across the stack matters.

  • CMDB / Asset Management: Experience configuring and maintaining a CMDB or IT asset management system (JSM Assets, ServiceNow CMDB, or equivalent).

  • ITSM & ITIL Knowledge: Strong understanding of ITSM processes and ITIL v3/v4 frameworks — including incident, change, problem, and request management — with the ability to configure platform workflows that enforce these processes at scale.

  • Security & Compliance Awareness: Understanding of IT General Controls (ITGC), access governance, and audit-readiness requirements. Experience supporting external audit engagements is a plus.

  • Atlassian Certifications (Plus): ACP-620 (Jira Service Management), ACP-120 (Jira Administrator), or ACP-420 (Confluence Administrator) are highly valued.

    • Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities — you see patterns others miss and turn complexity into clean solutions.

  • Highly autonomous and pragmatic: you make concrete progress in the face of ambiguity and imperfect information, without waiting for perfect requirements.

  • Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize across competing demands and manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

  • Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo — and to give and receive direct feedback in the service of continuous improvement.

  • Excellent communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Fluent in English, written and verbal.

  • Collaborative by nature: you share information and ideas freely, and you understand that the best solutions emerge from collective thinking.

  • Leadership mindset: you take ownership of initiatives end-to-end and drive them to completion with accountability and autonomy.

  • Values "done" over "perfect" — while continuously looking for ways to improve processes and deliver measurable impact.

Position description
 

The primary goal of the Information Security team is to earn deep trust with our rapidly growing customer base by relentlessly safeguarding Sonar products and the supporting cloud platforms, while consistently demonstrating that Sonar meets demanding, industry‑leading security standards.

You will champion security by design, partnering with product, platform, and infrastructure engineering teams so that our products and cloud platforms are imagined, built, and operated to Sonar’s high security bar.

lists.content:
• Shape secure products and cloud architecture

    • Partner with product and engineering teams from the earliest design stages to build secure, resilient solutions by design.

    • Review product architectures and AWS environments, ensuring security requirements meaningfully inform technical decisions and final designs.

      • Lead security assurance and improvement

      • Deliver high-impact initiatives from the strategic security plan, from evaluating new approaches to deploying modern security tools and capabilities across the organization.

      • Plan and manage independent security assessments, penetration tests, and red-team exercises; translate findings into practical improvements and customer-facing trust artifacts.

      • Investigate complex product and internal security findings, identify root causes, and help teams implement durable remediation.

        • Strengthen customer trust and incident readiness

        • Lead the investigation and resolution of customer security concerns with rigor and empathy, using each engagement to reinforce confidence in our security program.

        • Serve as a security subject-matter expert during incidents, helping teams understand, contain, and learn from emerging threats. Occasional on-call participation may be required.

          • Anticipate threats and scale the security program

          • Monitor and interpret threat intelligence, turning changes in the threat landscape into prioritized risks and actionable recommendations.

          • Continuously improve and automate security processes, increasing the quality, speed, and visibility of information that informs the security strategy.

Secure product and cloud architecture

  • Extensive experience with application and cloud architectures, predominantly AWS, and a strong interest in how modern cloud patterns can strengthen or weaken security.

  • Extensive experience conducting application security assessments, including code review and evaluation of authentication and authorization designs.

  • Experience assessing and securing AI and agentic AI capabilities, with the curiosity to experiment, learn, and help define emerging best practices.

  • Experience applying threat-modeling approaches, such as STRIDE, to improve design discussions and identify risks early.

    • Security assurance and remediation

    • Experience with penetration testing, red-team engagements, and bug-bounty programs, with an attacker mindset focused on protecting what matters most.

    • Experience investigating and managing vulnerabilities, from triage and prioritization through to remediation and organizational learning.

      • Threat awareness and security automation

      • Practical experience using AI to automate repeatable security work, along with enthusiasm for building small tools and experiments that make security teams faster and more effective.

      • Familiarity with Azure, GCP, and Google Workspace is a plus, as is the appetite to learn new platforms and ecosystems as Sonar evolves.
This role is based in Geneva, Switzerland. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

lists.text: We value diversity, equity, and inclusion
lists.content:
At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com. 

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

data.descriptionBody:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.

  • Obsessed with quality.

  • Deliberate in our decisions.

  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description
 

The primary goal of the Information Security team is to earn deep trust with our rapidly growing customer base by relentlessly safeguarding Sonar products and the supporting cloud platforms, while consistently demonstrating that Sonar meets demanding, industry‑leading security standards.


You will champion security by design, partnering with product, platform, and infrastructure engineering teams so that our products and cloud platforms are imagined, built, and operated to Sonar’s high security bar.

Position description

 
We are still at the beginning of our growth journey, so we are putting new processes, technologies, and tools in place on a continuous basis. Your role is a pivotal engineering contributor to the tooling and services to automate and enhance the software development lifecycle, empowering our fellow SonarSourcers to deliver with speed, confidence, and security. You would be a member of a team that delivers solutions across all of our 5 offices: Austin (Texas, US), Geneva (Switzerland), Bochum (Germany) and Singapore.
 
As a Major Incident Manager, you use and create automation tools to monitor and observe production infrastructure services both on premises and in the cloud. You are allergic to repetitive tasks, preferring to maximize automation and reliability. You are expert in change management, infrastructure management, system support, and configuration management.

lists.content:
• Cloud platform engineering through code: Design and evolve secure, reliable AWS foundations using reusable infrastructure-as-code, automated deployment pipelines, and tested change controls.

  • Automation and self-service: Develop pragmatic tooling, integrations, and glue code that solve operational problems for Systems Engineering and make internal customers more self-sufficient.

  • AI-enabled platform engineering: Use and develop AI-enabled tooling and automation to improve infrastructure delivery, operational triage, knowledge retrieval, and self-service, with appropriate human review, security, and governance.

  • Reliability and observability: Define and improve monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, SLIs/SLOs, capacity planning, and service-health reporting for Systems Engineering services.

  • Security engineering: Design, architect, implement, and operate secure cloud controls — including least-privilege access, policy-as-code, secrets management, auditability, configuration baselines, and automated evidence collection — in partnership with Information Security.

  • Incident response: Participate in the Systems Engineering on-call and escalation model for services and tools owned by Systems Engineering. Lead or contribute to incident response, root-cause analysis, and preventative follow-up work.

  • Resilience engineering: Lead or facilitate FMEAs and recovery exercises for critical cloud services and material changes; translate findings into funded, owned engineering actions.

  • Technical leadership: Produce lightweight designs, establish standards, review complex changes, mentor peers, and influence service-owning teams to adopt reliable platform patterns.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Systems Engineering, S/NOC, Information Security, IT Ops, Product Engineering, and external providers to define clean service boundaries and effective escalation paths.

• 8+ years of hands-on experience in cloud, platform, site reliability, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering in a SaaS, cloud-native, or complex enterprise environment.

  • Strong AWS experience, including networking, IAM, DNS, logging/monitoring, compute, storage, security controls, and multi-account or multi-environment design.

  • Deep infrastructure-as-code experience with AWS CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent, including reusable modules, automated testing, code review, and CI/CD delivery.

  • Strong software engineering and automation skills in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Bash, or a comparable language with a heavy emphasis on AI skillsets.

  • Experience designing production-grade observability: metrics, logs, traces, actionable alerting, dashboards, and operational runbooks.

  • Demonstrated ability to automate operational controls and remove manual work while preserving appropriate approvals, auditability, and safety.

  • Experience with incident response, post-incident engineering, root-cause analysis, and translating lessons into measurable reliability improvements.

  • Sound knowledge of cloud security principles: identity and access management, least privilege, encryption, secrets handling, secure networking, vulnerability management, and logging.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication; able to explain technical decisions, risks, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

data.descriptionPlain:
Who is Sonar?
Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.
Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.
We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow,Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:
SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.
Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:
Committed to our customers and community.
Obsessed with quality.
Deliberate in our decisions.
Effective as one team.
With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.
Position description
 
As a member of one of our platform engineering squads, you will leverage your experience and expertise to design and develop cloud-based solutions. Position description
 

As a member of one of our platform engineering squads, you will leverage your experience and expertise to design and develop cloud-based solutions. This means implementing massively scalable services, automating all system operations, measuring and continuously improving service quality, and making the lives of other developers easier.

lists.content:
• Develop, enhance, and operate cloud solutions on AWS with a focus on automation, high performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency.

  • Take part in the definition of novel cloud solution designs and lead their development.

  • Work in sprints with other engineers (backend, frontend, SRE, and other CPEs) as part of a cross-functional team to deliver new features into production. 

  • Collaborate with other squads in Product Development and Mission Control to ensure solutions fit into the Sonar platform.

  • Contribute to your squad’s efforts in operating its services through, i.e., definition and upkeeping SLOs, investigate alarms and respond to incidents to maintain a high quality of service.

Must Have: 

  • 2+ years of experience with architecting, developing, and operating cloud solutions on AWS for Web/API applications.

  • Knowledge of AWS networking and the following core AWS services: CloudFront, CloudWatch, ECS, Lambda, RDS, andSNS, SQS. 

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with at least one of the following tools: AWS CDK (preferred), AWS CloudFormation or Terraform/OpenTofu.

  • Experience with at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C# or similar.

  • Experience with at least one scripting language such as Bash or similar.

  • Experience with on-call for operating global services.

  • Experience working in an agile environment.

  • Strong DevOps mindset.

    • Nice to have:

  • Proficiency with AWS DynamoDB or OpenSearch.

  • Proficiency with Ansible or other IaC solutions.

  • Experience with distributed application architecture and development.

  • AWS Developer Associate Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer, or other valid, relevant AWS certifications.

  • Experience with one or more programming languages such as Python (preferred), Java, or similar.

  • Experience with AI enablement platform.
This role is based in Geneva, Switzerland. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

Position description
We are hiring a Corporate Accounting Manager to help build and scale our growing finance organization. This role goes beyond traditional close and reporting, you will help design processes, strengthen controls, develop and implement AI tooling, and partner cross-functionally to ensure financial accuracy as our operations grow in complexity.
The Corporate Accounting Manager will play a critical role in day-to-day accounting operations while helping evolve systems, policies, and workflows that support multi-entity operations.
What you will do
Prepare and review journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules across core balance sheet and P&L accounts.
Lead process improvement and transformation initiatives that strengthen reporting quality, efficiency, scalability, and controls
Identify and implement opportunities to use automation, technology, and AI-enabled solutions within management reporting processes
Mentor and develop accounting team members and serve as a trusted resource across the broader finance organization.
Assist with ongoing audits and liaise with external auditors
Experience and qualifications
The ideal candidate will: 
AI experience Direct experience designing, building, and deploying AI agents 
Big 4 foundation with industry depth: 7+ years of experience, preferably in software
Strong knowledge of GAAP, internal controls, and audit readiness, along with proficiency in accounting software and Excel, is desirable.
Demonstrated ability to work on-site, collaborate across teams, communicate clearly, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment is expected.
Relevant qualifications include a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or similar certification is preferred.

We're launching Customer Success Engineering — a brand-new function at Sonar. As a founding CSE, you'll help write the playbook. Position description
 
Sonar is looking for a CVP of Design to own the end-to-end design vision and execution across our product portfolio. Reporting to the CPO, this is Sonar's most senior design leadership role,  responsible for setting design strategy, scaling a high-performing global design organization, and ensuring our products deliver an exceptional, cohesive experience for developers and enterprise customers alike. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Executive Leadership to translate customer needs and market trends into design decisions that drive measurable business impact.

lists.content:
• Own the end-to-end product design vision, including visual design, interaction design, workflows, and overall platform evolution across Sonar's product line.

  • Define and drive a design strategy that ties directly to measurable business outcomes, working with Product and Engineering leadership to prioritize investments. Track and report on design's impact on key business and product metrics.

  • Build, scale, and lead a global design organization, including hiring, mentoring, and developing design talent to foster a high-performing, creative, and inclusive team culture.

  • Champion and evolve Sonar's design systems and UX best practices, ensuring consistency and quality across a complex, technical, developer-facing product suite.

  • Guide the design approach for agentic and AI-driven features, ensuring the team understands emerging patterns and best practices in this space.

  • Engage directly with customers, users, and industry leaders to gather insights, and translate those insights into actionable, high-impact design solutions.

  • Represent design at the executive level, communicating strategy, trade-offs, and progress to executive leadership and cross-functional, global stakeholders.

  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering to ensure design is embedded early in the product development process, not bolted on at the end.

• 7+ years of management experience in product design, UX, or a related field, with a proven track record of leading and scaling teams globally.

  • Demonstrated success in end-to-end product design leadership, including visual design, interaction design, workflows, strategic product thinking, and platform evolution.

  • Deep expertise in design systems and UX best practices, including experience designing for developer tools, API based tools, or similar technical/complex products.

  • Good understanding of the agentic domain and how it shapes product and design decisions.

  • Experience defining design strategy that drives measurable business outcomes.

  • Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across executive leadership, cross-functional teams, and global stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to mentor and develop design talent, fostering a high-performing, creative, and inclusive global design culture.

  • Deep understanding of customer needs and market trends, with experience engaging directly with users and industry leaders to translate insights into actionable, high-impact design solutions.
This role is based in London. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in London, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

lists.content:
• Own the end-to-end product design vision, including visual design, interaction design, workflows, and overall platform evolution across Sonar's product line.

  • Define and drive a design strategy that ties directly to measurable business outcomes, working with Product and Engineering leadership to prioritize investments. Track and report on design's impact on key business and product metrics.

  • Good understanding of the agentic domain and how it shapes product and design decisions.

  • Experience defining design strategy that drives measurable business outcomes.

lists.content:
Operating within the Data & Insights team, your mission is to decode customer behaviors and transform product engagement into high-impact, actionable intelligence. By bridging the gap between product adoption and commercial data, you will construct a holistic view of user health and the tangible value we provide.

You will take full ownership of the product-usage analytics lifecycle. This involves hands-on data exploration, hypothesis testing, and deep collaboration with Data and Analytics Engineers to architect the foundational models you require. Success is defined by analytical rigor and your ability to steer strategic product and Go-to-Market (GTM) decisions.

Embedded in our central Data & Insights department, this role serves as a strategic partner to our Product organisation, driving cross-functional synergy with other departments, engineering, and data science teams to maximize overall success.

Success depends on genuinely understanding the product you're analyzing, not just the data behind it.

• Understand product usage. Work closely with product managers (PMs), building a deep understanding of the product itself, to analyze how customers adopt and use it, and identify patterns in engagement, feature usage, and retention.to Analyze how customers adopt and use the product, and identify patterns in engagement, feature usage, and retention.

  • Connect usage to outcomes. Link product usage data to customer and sales data to reveal how usage relates to expansion, churn risk, and account health.

  • Define usage-based signals. Build the logic behind usage scoring, health indicators, and other metrics that translate behavior into insights that drive activation, retention, and expansion. 

  • Be proactive. Explore product, sales, and customer data to surface findings nobody asked for. Anticipate the next question.

  • Run experiments and validate. Test which usage signals actually predict outcomes, applying sound statistical methods and being honest about significance and causality.

  • Partner on the data foundation. Work with Data and Analytics Engineers to get product and sales data into the warehouse and modeled well. Define requirements and contribute to data models that connect product usage with customer and sales data.

  • Tell the story. Communicate insights clearly to stakeholders across the business, and document context, caveats, and decisions so the work survives handoffs.

• Deep product understanding and a track record of working effectively with PMs, translating product knowledge and usage data into decisions they act on. 

  • Strong analytical track record: someone who has measurably influenced revenue, product, or GTM decisions through analysis, not just produced reports.

  • Comfort with the latest AI tools, and a habit of using them to work faster and sharper: You stay current as the tooling evolves and bring new approaches to the team.

  • Eagerness to develop: you actively grow your skills, seek feedback, and treat new tools and methods as opportunities rather than threats.

  • Solid SQL. You can independently query, join, and explore data without waiting for someone to prepare it for you.

  • Proficiency in Python for analysis, modeling, and automation. Experience with ML and statistical libraries (e.g. scikit-learn, statsmodels) for modeling, prediction, and inference.

  • Statistical foundation: experimentation, significance testing, regression, segmentation, forecasting, and the judgment to know which applies.

  • Working knowledge of how product usage connects to revenue: funnels, cohorts, retention, account health, and the realities of joining product usage data with CRM and sales data.

  • Willingness to get hands-on with data modeling. You don't need to be a dbt expert, but you must be comfortable exploring messy data and partnering on (or building) the models you need rather than waiting for clean tables.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills: you can challenge weak measurement respectfully and make a recommendation, not just present options.

  • Proactivity and autonomy: you raise your hand early, plan your own work, and look for impact without being asked.

lists.content:
• Create the courses, labs, and learning content that teach Sonar customers and partners how to get maximum value from SonarQube — accelerating adoption, reducing time-to-value, and building lasting product competency.
  • Help build Sonar's Partner Accreditation Program from scratch, developing the sales and technical content that enables partners to independently deliver Sonar revenue motions at scale.
  • Bridge the gap between complex technical capabilities and the people who need to use them — whether that's a developer integrating SonarQube into a CI/CD pipeline or a partner SE leading a customer migration.
  • Contribute to a growing education function that is central to Sonar's commercial strategy, with your content directly influencing partner-led pipeline and customer retention.

• Research, write, and maintain high-quality course content for both customer and partner audiences — covering topics including SonarQube installation and configuration, Agentic software development methodology, CI/CD integration, and migration paths from SonarQube Server to SonarQube Cloud.

  • Develop content across formats: written modules, video scripts, lab exercises, knowledge checks, and assessment questions — working closely with Instructional Designers to bring each course to life.

  • Adapt existing customer-facing content for the partner persona, ensuring the framing, depth, and emphasis are appropriate for partner AEs, BDMs, SEs, and implementation engineers.

  • Publish and maintain courses in the LMS, keeping content accurate and up to date as the product evolves.

  • Collaborate with technical SMEs, Product, and Customer Success to ensure all content is technically accurate and reflects real-world workflows.

  • Use AI tools to accelerate content development, improve consistency, and scale output without sacrificing quality.

  • Identify gaps in the learning catalog and proactively propose content to address them, informed by customer feedback, support trends, and product releases.

• At least 3 years of experience creating technical content for developer or technical practitioner audiences — tutorials, documentation, eLearning, or similar.

  • A working understanding of software development practices: you're comfortable discussing CI/CD pipelines, code quality concepts, DevOps workflows, and cloud vs. self-hosted deployment models.

  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, structured, accessible content — without dumbing it down for the audience who needs it.

  • Experience working across content formats, including written and video (scripting, on-camera, or voiceover experience is a plus).

  • Familiarity with LMS platforms and the mechanics of publishing and maintaining eLearning courses.

  • Strong collaboration skills — you work well with SMEs, Instructional Designers, and cross-functional stakeholders to produce accurate, polished output.

  • Hands-on experience with SonarQube (any edition) is a strong advantage; familiarity with static analysis, SAST, or code security concepts is a plus.

  • Experience writing for both customer and partner/channel audiences is desirable but not required.

lists.content:
• Define and evangelize: Own the positioning and messaging hierarchy for the Sonar platform, grounded in customer outcomes rather than feature lists, and carry that narrative across every stage of the customer journey.

  • Shape the AI narrative: Build Sonar's point of view on the AC/DC (agentic SDLC), including AI coding tools, coding agents, and LLM-generated code, based on hands-on use of tools like Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Windsurf.

  • Present to customers and the market: Deliver compelling presentations directly to customers and prospects, and represent Sonar on stage at major AI coding and developer events as a recognized voice in the space.

  • Energize sales: Build and deliver enablement content and positioning that does more than inform the sales team. It should get them genuinely excited and confident to sell in AI-driven deals.

  • Orchestrate cross-functionally: Act as the connective link between Product, Engineering, Sales, Demand Gen, Customer Success, PR, and Analyst Relations to keep go-to-market aligned.

  • Track the market: Maintain a sharp view of the competitive landscape across DevOps, AppSec, and AI tools, and turn that into input for product and sales strategy.

  • Build analyst and PR relationships: Partner with communications on analyst briefings (Gartner, Forrester) and media relationships that reinforce Sonar's leadership in code quality and security.

The ideal candidate will: 

  • Proven leadership: 10+ years in Product Marketing within DevOps, AppSec, or Enterprise Software, including 2+ years at Principal level or higher. Experience working closely with developers is a strong plus.

  • Technical depth: Engineering degree or equivalent technical background preferred, with real understanding of the SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, and modern AI-native development.

  • Hands-on agentic AI experience: Regular, current use of agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, or similar) and a clear, informed point of view on how AI agents are changing software engineering. This is not theoretical knowledge, it is practiced.

  • Public and customer-facing presence: A track record of delivering strong presentations directly to customers and speaking at AI coding or developer conferences. You are comfortable being the face of the product in front of a room.

  • Sales enablement that lands: Experience building enablement programs that get sales teams excited to sell, not just trained on talking points.

  • Strategic storytelling: Ability to connect technical detail to business value for both developers and executive buyers.

  • Analyst relations: Experience engaging industry analysts and participating in major research evaluations (Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave).

  • Communication mastery: Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex ideas for any audience.
