Position description

 
We are still at the beginning of our growth journey, so we are putting new processes, technologies, and tools in place on a continuous basis. Your role is a pivotal engineering contributor to the tooling and services to automate and enhance the software development lifecycle, empowering our fellow SonarSourcers to deliver with speed, confidence, and security. You would be a member of a team that delivers solutions across all of our 5 offices: Austin (Texas, US), Geneva (Switzerland), Bochum (Germany) and Singapore.
 
As a Major Incident Manager, you use and create automation tools to monitor and observe production infrastructure services both on premises and in the cloud. You are allergic to repetitive tasks, preferring to maximize automation and reliability. You are expert in change management, infrastructure management, system support, and configuration management.

lists.content:
• System Health Monitoring, Alert Triaging, and Error Budget Management: Dedicate time to monitoring critical security infrastructure (e.g., identity platforms, firewalls, compliance systems) and core infrastructure components. Focus on using and maintaining dashboards tied to Service Level Objectives (SLOs), triaging high-severity alerts, and analyzing the current Error Budget burn rate to guide prioritization for the rest of the day.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Policy as Code Development: Spend the largest portion of time writing, reviewing, and testing code (e.g., Python, Go, Terraform, or proprietary tools) to automate the deployment, configuration, and security hardening of infrastructure. This involves treating infrastructure and security policies as software to ensure consistency and prevent configuration drift.
  • Toil Elimination and Automation of Operational Tasks: Identify, scope, and implement automated solutions for manual, repetitive, and time-consuming tasks (toil) related to security patching, compliance checks, certificate rotations, or infrastructure maintenance. The goal is to continuously reduce the operational workload for the team.
  • Security Pipeline and Observability Maintenance: Maintain and enhance the DevSecOps security tools integrated into the CI/CD pipelines (e.g., static analysis, vulnerability scanning, security configuration checks). Ensure the end-to-end logging, metrics, and tracing (observability) systems for both infrastructure and security tools are robust, accurate, and provide immediate diagnostic capability during incidents.
  • Incident Response Engineering and Post-Mortem Action: Participate in the on-call rotation and actively engage in engineering solutions derived from post-mortems. This means turning incident root causes into preventative measures implemented via code, improving runbooks into automated actions, and reducing Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR) for future incidents.

• Deep IaC Expertise: Professional experience provisioning and managing complex infrastructure using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation (AWS), or similar tools like Ansible or Puppet for configuration management.
  • Cloud/Platform Experience: Hands-on experience with a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure) or managing large-scale internal/private cloud infrastructure.
  • SLO/SLI Implementation: Practical experience defining, measuring, and reporting on Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for critical services.
  • Logging/Metrics/Tracing Stacks: Proven experience with modern observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, proprietary systems, or vendor solutions like Datadog/Splunk) for proactive issue identification.
  • Networking: Strong understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, Load Balancing, Firewalls, Proxies) sufficient to debug complex service connectivity and latency issues.
  • Automation of Security Controls: Experience implementing security best practices via code, such as automated vulnerability scanning, configuration hardening, secret management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault), and key rotation.
  • Identity and Access Management (IAM): Practical experience managing large-scale IAM systems (e.g., implementing least-privilege policies, single sign-on).
  • Incident Management: Experience running or significantly contributing to post-incident reviews (post-mortems) and prioritizing resulting engineering work (error budget management).

lists.content:
• Generate new leads and opportunities within an assigned account set, representing our largest and most strategic existing customer base at Sonar via upselling and cross-selling.
  • Ensure that minimum requirements are established, managed and maintained with customers, such as quarterly business reviews.
  • Onboard customers throughout their entire journey with SonarSource commercial products.
  • Develop relationships with champions within existing customer accounts.
  • Size and quote customer software license needs.
  • Negotiate and close upgrades to existing implementations.
  • Interact with customers over phone, email, video conference, and on-site meetings when necessary.
  • Support marketing efforts with account-based customer-focused marketing campaigns.
  • Pro-actively engage in building, growing and sharing sales team best practices.
  • Accurately capture and report all aspects of account and opportunity information within the SFDC platform.
  • Utilize Salesforce.com to set daily activity and accurately forecast opportunity pipeline.

• Proven successful 5+ years of experience in a B2B sales role, ideally in a SaaS or subscription model. 
  • Focus on building and managing customer relationships. 
  • Experience selling a technical product to a technical buyer.
  • Proven expertise in account planning and prospecting, using various channels and tools for prospecting, such as Zoominfo, LinkedIn, calling and networking.
  • Expertise in navigating and growing a pipeline in existing customer accounts and taking a deal from Lead Qualification to Closed Won.
  • Familiarity in supporting and selling to large enterprise customers and managing and negotiating larger (>100kUSD) enterprise deals.
  • Ability to drive the sales process effectively through phone calls, emails, and virtual and on-site meetings.
  • Proficiency in communicating with executive-level contacts and delivering value messages based on the persona you are engaging with (bottom/up and top/down approach)
  • Salesforce.com lover; you know it and can’t imagine sales without it.
  • Customer-Centric focus; We Want Happy Customers.
  • Written and spoken English at a professional level.

• Flexible comprehensive employee benefit package.

  • We encourage usage of our robust time-off allocations. You will receive 25 days of PTO per calendar year (on a pro-rated basis depending on your employment start date), with additional time provided for sickness, life events and holidays.

  • We offer an exciting 401(k) plan that has a 4% match, fully vested on day one of participation.

  • Fully paid parking in the heart of downtown Austin, Texas.

  • Global workforce with employees in 20+ countries representing 35+ unique nationalities.

  • We have an annual kick-off somewhere in the world where we meet to build relationships and goals for the company.

  • Monthly catered events, and team events

lists.content:
Use your problem-solving abilities and customer focus to evangelize the code quality management philosophy embraced by over 400,000 organizations. Utilize your proven sales skills to highlight product value, drive adoptions, and significantly expand our customer base.
 
Engage with developers, decision-makers, and procurement in diverse industries and company sizes. Seize this opportunity to directly influence the direction and processes of our Sales Team and organization as we grow. This is your chance to drive sales success and impact our upward trajectory!
 
We're open to the right candidates across all remote locations for this role, please apply and tell us where you're based.

• Pipeline Agency & Math: Taking full ownership of your revenue engine by managing 30–40+ active opportunities; you treat SDR support as a multiplier, not a crutch.
  • Manufacturing Urgency: Proactively pivoting long-cycle enterprise "evaluations" into 30-day transactions by identifying high-stakes "Why Now" business drivers.
  • SDR Partnership & Strategy: Collaborating with your SDR to map Tier 1 accounts, ensuring a relentless "hunter" mindset is applied to every target.
  • Friction Removal: Navigating complex security and legal hurdles for deals using standardized processes to prevent cycle bloat.
  • AI-Leveraged Execution: Using AI to re-engineer manual research and personalization tasks, allowing you to handle enterprise-level complexity at velocity.

• Enterprise Pedigree: 8+ years selling technical solutions into large/global companies with a track record of navigating complex stakeholder maps.
  • High-Volume Execution: Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced inside sales environment. You're just as comfortable closing a $50k deal as you are navigating a $150k, $250k, or $500k opportunity — and you know how to manage both motions without losing momentum on either end.
  • Operational Discipline: Expert-level "pipeline math" fluency; you know your conversion ratios and take pride in a high-activity calendar.
  • Resilience & "Slickness": A "closer" mindset that prioritizes momentum over nurturing, with the professional confidence to disqualify slow-moving leads.
  • Digital Fluency: Advanced use of AI and modern sales tech to create leverage and speed in your daily workflow.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

lists.content:
Use your problem-solving abilities and customer focus to evangelize the code quality management philosophy embraced by over 400,000 organizations. Utilize your proven sales skills to highlight product value, drive adoptions, and significantly expand our customer base.
 
Engage with developers, decision-makers, and procurement in diverse industries and company sizes. Seize this opportunity to directly influence the direction and processes of our Sales Team and organization as we grow. This is your chance to drive sales success and impact our upward trajectory!

• Pipeline Agency & Math: Taking full ownership of your revenue engine by managing 30–40+ active opportunities; you treat SDR support as a multiplier, not a crutch.
  • Manufacturing Urgency: Proactively pivoting long-cycle enterprise "evaluations" into 30-day transactions by identifying high-stakes "Why Now" business drivers.
  • SDR Partnership & Strategy: Collaborating with your SDR to map Tier 1 accounts, ensuring a relentless "hunter" mindset is applied to every target.
  • Friction Removal: Navigating complex security and legal hurdles for deals using standardized processes to prevent cycle bloat.
  • AI-Leveraged Execution: Using AI to re-engineer manual research and personalization tasks, allowing you to handle enterprise-level complexity at velocity.

• Enterprise Pedigree: 8+ years selling technical solutions into large/global companies with a track record of navigating complex stakeholder maps.

  • Resilience & "Slickness": A "closer" mindset that prioritizes momentum over nurturing, with the professional confidence to disqualify slow-moving leads.

Position description

We are looking for a Manager, Customer Solutions Engineering to lead and build Sonar's Austin CSE hub. This is a founding leadership role: you will hire, develop, and inspire a team of Customer Solutions Engineers (CSEs), establish the operating culture and execution rhythm of the hub, and ensure the Austin CSE team delivers outstanding technical outcomes for Sonar's Mid-Market and Enterprise customers. You will work closely with Field Engineering leadership and cross-functional partners across Sales, Product, and Support to set the standard for how Sonar earns its customers’ love — at scale.

lists.content:
• Build and lead the Austin CSE Hub: Recruit, onboard, and develop a high-performing team of Customer Solutions Engineers. Set the culture, operating norms, and execution standards for the hub from day one, creating an environment where people grow fast and customers feel it.

  • Drive customer outcomes at scale: Own the technical health, product adoption, and value realization metrics across the hub's customer portfolio — spanning Mid-Market and Enterprise accounts — ensuring retention and expansion goals are met.

  • Coach and develop your team: Conduct regular 1:1s, career development conversations, and performance reviews. Cultivate a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence in CI/CD, Agentic SLDC practices, and Sonar platform expertise.

  • Establish hub operations: Define workflows, escalation paths, and collaboration rhythms that connect the team seamlessly with global counterparts in Austin, Bochum, Geneva, London, and beyond.

  • Partner cross-functionally: Serve as the voice of the hub in strategic planning, product feedback loops, and go-to-market initiatives. Work closely with Sales, Product, and Support leadership to align on priorities and resolve systemic customer challenges.

  • Represent Sonar's technical leadership externally: Engage with key customers and executives as an escalation point, trusted advisor, and advocate — reinforcing Sonar's value proposition at the highest levels.

  • Shape the team charter: Define the roles, hiring plan, and team structure needed to scale the hub in alignment with Sonar's growth trajectory.

The ideal candidate will:

  • Bring 8+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Customer Success Engineering, Technical Account Management, or similar customer-facing technical roles, with at least 3 years in a people management or team lead capacity.

  • Have a proven track record of building and scaling high-performing technical teams, ideally in a hub, greenfield office, or startup environment.

  • Demonstrate deep technical fluency in modern software development practices — CI/CD pipelines, code quality, DevSecOps, and Agentic/AI-assisted SLDC — sufficient to coach CSEs and engage credibly with enterprise engineering leaders.

  • Possess exceptional leadership and coaching skills, with the ability to motivate diverse teams, develop individual career paths, and hold a high bar for execution.

  • Have strong business acumen and customer empathy, with experience managing complex Enterprise and Mid-Market customer portfolios and navigating executive stakeholder relationships.

  • Be fluent in English; proficiency in Spanish or other European languages is a plus.

  • Be based in, or willing to relocate to, Austin.

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and embody Sonar's CODE values: Committed, Obsessed with quality, Deliberate, and Effective.

The Role:
We need a technical leader with a developer/DevSecOps background who is motivated to lead a team driving a high-velocity sales engine. This is a player/coach role whose time is shared running opportunities in front of customers alongside developing, hiring, and raising the bar for a team of Solutions Engineers doing that same work. You carry the team's number, not a personal one, and you earn credibility with your team by still doing the job yourself.

lists.content:
• Technical Solution Selling: Proactively removing technical blockers (Security, Architecture, Legal) using standardized, repeatable processes to move the sales process forward, whether the deal is $50K or $500K.

  • Coaching in the Field: Riding along on your team's calls and giving feedback specific enough to act on. Not "that went well," but "you spent nine minutes on features the platform lead never asked about." Weekly 1:1s, individual development plans, and honest conversations about where people stand.

  • Hiring and Bar-Setting: Owning your requisitions end to end, from screening through technical interview and close. You define what a Sonar SE looks like and you hold that bar, including when the pipeline is thin and the pressure is on to settle.

  • Team Goal Attainment: Knowing where every meaningful opportunity in your team's portfolio stands, where it's stuck, and what you're doing about it. Forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene are yours.

  • SE-AE Partnership at Scale: Building the working relationships between your SEs and their AE counterparts and making sure that engagement is visible in Salesforce. If the team is doing the work but not logging it, that's a coaching problem and it's yours to solve.

  • Value Engineering: Roleplaying as a peer to Lead Engineers and DevOps Directors to articulate the technical risk of shipping AI-generated code without verification, and teaching your team to run that same conversation.

  • Bionic SE Workflows: Leveraging AI to automate the creation of customer-facing content, allowing you to handle a high volume of deals at pace, then turning what works into something the whole team uses.

• The "Sales-First" Mindset: You are driven by win rates and sales velocity; you view a long, un-qualified technical evaluation as a failure, not a project.

  • Developer DNA: Proven background as a Software Developer or extensive experience in the Developer Tools (DevTools) space; you can speak "engineer-to-engineer" with credibility, and your team will respect you for it.

  • High-Scale Muscle Memory: Experience in a high-velocity environment where you have personally managed a double-digit load of active, concurrent technical evaluations, plus exposure to larger enterprise cycles.

  • Coaching Instinct, With or Without the Title: You have formally managed SEs, or you have been the person on the team everyone else learns from. We care more about evidence that people got better because of you than about the size of your last org.

  • Technical "Slickness": Professional polish and executive presence; the ability to translate complex code-level issues into business-level ROI for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Operational Discipline: A self-driven attitude with a focus on "Standardization over Customization" to keep the revenue engine moving at speed, and comfort making decisions from data rather than gut feel.

  • AI Power User: You actively use AI to re-engineer your technical sales workflow, and you teach it. If it can be automated or prompted, you've already done it.

Position description

As Sonar’s Marketing AI Engineer, you design, build, and maintain the AI agents and automated workflows that multiply the impact of the marketing function. You spend time with marketing stakeholders to understand their work in depth, identify where automation creates real leverage, and then build and iterate until it works well. You produce clear reporting on efficiency and impact, keeping marketing leadership informed on what the automations are actually delivering.

The best person for this role might be a marketing ops veteran who has taught themselves to build with AI, or an automation engineer who has gone deep on how marketing actually works. Either way, what matters is the combination: you understand marketing processes from the inside, and you can build reliable automations that make those processes faster, smarter, and more scalable.

lists.content:
• Map and prioritize automation opportunities: Work closely with marketing teams to develop a deep understanding of their day-to-day processes — identifying where AI agents and automated workflows can eliminate manual work, reduce errors, or unlock capabilities that weren’t previously possible.

  • Design and build AI agents: Develop AI agents and automated workflows that streamline marketing processes — from content production and campaign operations to reporting, lead routing, and personalization at scale.

  • Deploy and maintain automations: Own the full lifecycle of deployed agents — from initial release through ongoing monitoring, debugging, and iteration — ensuring reliability and performance as usage grows.

  • Produce efficiency and impact reporting: Track and report on workflow automation metrics — time saved, error rates, throughput, and business impact — delivering regular dashboards and summaries to marketing leadership.

  • Stay current on AI tooling: Continuously evaluate new AI models, agent frameworks, and automation platforms — bringing a clear point of view on what Sonar marketing should adopt, experiment with, or build on next.

  • Partner with Marketing Tooling & AI Operations: Collaborate closely with the Marketing Tooling & AI Operations Manager to understand the existing tool stack, ensure automations integrate reliably with it, and drive adoption of new AI-powered capabilities.

  • Ensure data quality and governance: Design automations that handle marketing data responsibly — with attention to data quality, privacy, and auditability across all deployed workflows.

  • Document and enable: Produce clear documentation for all deployed agents and workflows, and run internal enablement sessions to help the marketing team understand and effectively use what you have built.

• Have 3+ years of experience in marketing operations, automation engineering, or a closely related role — with a track record of building workflows or automations that measurably improved team efficiency.

  • Have deep, hands-on knowledge of marketing processes and tools — including CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation, campaign ops, analytics, and content workflows. A marketing ops practitioner who has grown into building automations is a strong fit.

  • Be experienced with no-code/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Make, Zapier, n8n) and comfortable extending them with scripting when needed (Python and/or JavaScript).

  • Have working familiarity with AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants) or a demonstrated ability and appetite to ramp quickly.

  • Be experienced integrating with third-party APIs and working with marketing data structures (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, GA, Marketo).

  • Have strong analytical skills and experience building performance dashboards and reporting for deployed automations.

  • Be a clear communicator who can explain what an automation does — and why it matters — to non-technical stakeholders, and translate their requirements into precise technical specifications.

  • Bring intellectual curiosity and a bias to build — you stay current on the fast-moving AI landscape and bring that knowledge into your everyday work.

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.

lists.content:
• Map and prioritize automation opportunities: Work closely with marketing teams to develop a deep understanding of their day-to-day processes — identifying where AI agents and automated workflows can eliminate manual work, reduce errors, or unlock capabilities that weren’t previously possible.

  • Design and build AI agents: Develop AI agents and automated workflows that streamline marketing processes — from content production and campaign operations to reporting, lead routing, and personalization at scale.

  • Deploy and maintain automations: Own the full lifecycle of deployed agents — from initial release through ongoing monitoring, debugging, and iteration — ensuring reliability and performance as usage grows.

  • Produce efficiency and impact reporting: Track and report on workflow automation metrics — time saved, error rates, throughput, and business impact — delivering regular dashboards and summaries to marketing leadership.

  • Stay current on AI tooling: Continuously evaluate new AI models, agent frameworks, and automation platforms — bringing a clear point of view on what Sonar marketing should adopt, experiment with, or build on next.

  • Partner with Marketing Tooling & AI Operations: Collaborate closely with the Marketing Tooling & AI Operations Manager to understand the existing tool stack, ensure automations integrate reliably with it, and drive adoption of new AI-powered capabilities.

• Have 3+ years of experience in marketing operations, automation engineering, or a closely related role — with a track record of building workflows or automations that measurably improved team efficiency.

  • Be experienced integrating with third-party APIs and working with marketing data structures (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, GA, Marketo).

  • Have strong analytical skills and experience building performance dashboards and reporting for deployed automations.

  • Be a clear communicator who can explain what an automation does — and why it matters — to non-technical stakeholders, and translate their requirements into precise technical specifications.

  • Bring intellectual curiosity and a bias to build — you stay current on the fast-moving AI landscape and bring that knowledge into your everyday work.

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.

Sonar’s marketing technology stack is a strategic asset — and this role owns it. As Marketing Tooling & AI Operations Manager, you are the business owner for our full suite of marketing platforms, including Google Analytics, Semrush, Profound, Qualified, and others. You define what we need from our tools, ensure they are configured and integrated correctly, and drive the adoption that turns investment into impact.

This is a role for someone equally comfortable in a business requirements conversation and inside a tool’s admin console. lists.content:
• Own the marketing technology stack: Serve as the business owner for Sonar’s full marketing tool suite — including GA, Semrush, Profound, Qualified, and others — managing vendor relationships, contract renewals, and platform health.

  • Define and govern tooling requirements: Translate marketing team needs into clear business requirements for tool configuration, integrations, and new capabilities — partnering with IT and RevOps to ensure proper implementation.

  • Drive platform adoption: Design onboarding workflows, enablement materials, and internal training programs that get marketing teams using tools effectively and consistently.

  • Capture and communicate value: Track and report on tool utilization, ROI, and impact across the stack — delivering regular updates to marketing leadership on what’s working, what’s underutilized, and where to invest next.

  • Evaluate and evolve the stack: Continuously assess the marketing technology landscape, identify gaps and redundancies, and make recommendations on new tools, replacements, or consolidations that improve efficiency and outcomes.

  • Manage tool integrations: Ensure data flows correctly between marketing platforms, CRM, and analytics systems — working with technical stakeholders to maintain clean, reliable data across the stack.

  • Partner on AI and automation: Work closely with the Marketing AI Engineer to identify automation opportunities, provide business context for workflow design, and champion adoption of AI-powered capabilities across the marketing team.

  • Manage budgets and vendors: Own the marketing technology budget, manage vendor contracts and renewals, and negotiate to maximize value for the business.

The ideal candidate will:

  • Have 4+ years of experience in marketing operations, marketing technology, or revenue operations — preferably within B2B SaaS or enterprise technology.

  • Bring hands-on experience managing marketing tool stacks, including analytics platforms (GA), SEO tools (Semrush), AI-powered intent tools (Profound), and conversational marketing platforms (Qualified) or equivalents.

  • Have a strong understanding of how marketing tools integrate with CRM systems (Salesforce) and marketing automation platforms.

  • Be skilled at translating business requirements into technical configurations and working with engineering or IT teams to implement them.

  • Have experience designing workflows and creating training materials that drive adoption across non-technical teams.

  • Be data-driven — comfortable building dashboards, analyzing tool utilization data, and presenting ROI findings to marketing leadership.

  • Be highly organized and capable of managing multiple tools, vendors, and stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Have strong communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally across marketing, IT, RevOps, and finance.

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems, or a related field.

lists.text: Why You Will Love it Here:
lists.content:
• Our culture and mission set us apart. We have a dynamic work culture that values respect and kindness and embraces the right to fail (and get right back up again!). 
  • Great people make a great company. We value people skills as much as technical skills and strive to keep things friendly while still being passionate leaders in our domains. 
  • We have a flexible work policy that includes 3 days in-office and 2 days work-from-home each week for those located near our office locations; some locations such as Dubai, India, Japan and Australia operate fully remotely.
  • We have a growth mindset. We love learning and believe continuous education is critical to our success. In an ever-changing industry, new skills are necessary, and we're happy to help our team acquire them.
  • As the leader in our field, our products and services are as strong as our internal team members.
  • We embrace transparency with regular meetings, cascading messages and updates on the growth and success of our organization.

data.opening:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

lists.text: On a daily basis, you will
lists.content:
• Perform technical assessments of prospective partners to ensure alignment with Sonar’s goals and their ability to drive adoption
  • Collaborate with partner’s sales teams to drive technical aspects of business opportunities by doing technical presentations and demonstrations, supporting product evaluations, and helping customers grow their usage of Sonar’s products
  • Advise partners on the best alignment of Sonar’s solution with their development and deployment strategies
  • Address technical inquiries and resolve technical problems encountered by partners and their prospects
  • Go beyond the sale to ensure successful product adoption and growth following the purchase
  • Travel to visit customers, attend conferences, and staff events as required

• Practical experience in software development or DevOps engineering which sets the stage for understanding our products and how they’re enjoyed by users
  • Experience (5 years+) supporting and scaling partner networks with a focus on positive customer outcomes
  • Prior track record of building joint solutions with GSI partners 
  • Understanding of the complexity of working with large consulting companies
  • Ability to translate technical aspects of our solutions to the executive level, including experience working with VP and C-level executives
  • Knowledge of the software delivery practices of large development organizations and how they integrate software quality and productivity use cases such as SAST and AI coding assistants
  • Working knowledge of both local and cloud-based software deployment platforms and technologies, including Linux, Windows, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure
  • Excellence in delivering compelling, unique demonstrations and presentations that help people understand software solutions
  • Ability to dive into complex technical problems, perform troubleshooting, develop solutions, and articulate them in verbal and written form
  • Proven ability to work in a team, receiving and giving feedback as well as sharing knowledge

Position description
Sonar is looking for a customer-centric Platform Product Manager to drive the foundational capabilities that make our products enterprise-ready, trusted by the world’s largest organizations and truly loved by developers around the world. You will be part of the Product Management team that drives the vision and roadmaps for our core platform infrastructure. We are currently looking for Product Managers with a deep technical background in enterprise SaaS capabilities.
This role sits at the intersection of core infrastructure and customer needs. As a Product Manager, you will shape our platform's core pillars to deliver an enterprise-grade, seamless experience our customers can trust. To achieve this perfect match, we need a passionate Product Manager who will research, clarify, prioritize the needs of external IT administrators, DevOps, and security teams, and translate those needs across our product line. You will become an expert user of our core platform, from very high-level user settings down to the technical aspects of our infrastructure.
You will join the Product Management team, which is composed of other passionate Product Managers eager to collaborate with you. You will also work closely with engaged Engineering teams to ensure that the proposed solutions meet the expected outcome and that we collectively deliver the best products to help teams adopt our software at scale to write better and more secure code. 
By joining us, you will bring your deep knowledge of enterprise-grade platforms (such as data sovereignty, encryption, or global performance scaling) and your experience as a Product Manager to help us reach the next level and provide an awesome user experience to millions of developers.

As a Product Manager, you will shape our platform's core pillars to deliver an enterprise-grade, seamless experience our customers can trust. You will join the Product Management team, which is composed of other passionate Product Managers eager to collaborate with you. lists.content:
• Contribute to the different areas of the Platform vision and communicate about them, internally and externally.

  • Research, clarify, and prioritize opportunities to build and maintain an effective roadmap, focused on customer trust and platform readiness.

  • Interact directly with our users and customers on our product forum to support them, integrate their feedback, and identify opportunities.

  • Develop a deep understanding of customer-facing platform needs (e.g., data residency, advanced access controls, and application performance) and how we can enable organizations to scale seamlessly..

  • Work closely with other product managers to design cross-product foundational features.

  • Align with the engineering and UX teams on the foundational system and usability problems to solve and support them during the end-to-end development stage of the solutions.

  • Sync with the engineering teams to ensure that there is a good balance between innovation, consolidation, and stability.

  • Attend conferences and give talks about platform scale if you like.

  • Help the Product Management team grow in its organization, tools, and processes.

• Passionate about enterprise software operability and the practices that lead to secure and highly available applications.

  • Deep understanding of core platform pillars (e.g., data isolation, customer-managed encryption, design systems, API best-practices, or global performance optimization).

  • Technical comprehension of self-hosted deployment, cloud-native environments, multi-region deployments, and data residency frameworks.

  • Experience with the latest developments in AI assisted coding and how they impact platform scale.

  • Experience in software product management, preferably managing platform products in an agile context.

  • Highly autonomous and pragmatic, with an obsession for solving external customer problems.

  • Open-minded and very positive can-do attitude.

  • Comfortable in dealing with change, complexity, and uncertainty.

  • Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo as well as to receive feedback.

  • Leadership: you take initiative and demonstrate your ability to lead a subject from beginning to end.

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

lists.content:
• Own product design for a squad and advocate for a world-class user experience.

  • Research and map complex user workflows to ensure our solutions are intuitive and highly functional.

  • Integrate AI into every stage of your design workflow, leveraging it to accelerate research synthesis, automate repetitive tasks, and explore high-fidelity prototypes more efficiently.

  • Listen to our users and customers to understand their needs. Develop a deep understanding of the SDLC and how we can enable developers and AI agents to produce better quality software.

  • Work closely with other product designers to ensure a cohesive information architecture and a unified experience across the entire product platform.

  • Align with your product manager on problem definition, providing design solutions throughout the end-to-end development stage.

  • Partner with engineering teams early in the design process to vet technical feasibility and uncover edge cases.

  • Help the Product Design team grow by contributing to our design processes, tools, and collaborative frameworks.

• Experience organizing data-heavy environments into logical structures and mapping user journeys that minimize friction.

  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience using AI tools to accelerate research, ideation and design velocity.

  • A self-starter mindset with the drive to identify UX gaps and propose structural improvements without being prompted.

  • Ability to articulate design decisions and the "why" behind them to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfort working in a cross-functional environment where feedback is shared openly and success is a team effort.

  • Delivery mindset. Your role does not end when the design is handed off.

  • Bonus points if you have a technical background in computer science or software development.

data.descriptionPlain:
Who is Sonar?
 
Sonar helps prevent code quality and code security issues from reaching production, amplifies developers' productivity in concert with AI assistants, and improves the developer experience with streamlined workflows. Sonar analyzes all code, regardless of who writes it — your internal team, genAI, or third parties — resulting in more secure, reliable, and maintainable applications. Rooted in the open source community, Sonar’s solutions support over 30 programming languages, frameworks, and infrastructure technologies. Today, Sonar is used by +7M developers and 400K organizations worldwide, including the DoD, Microsoft, NASA, MasterCard, Siemens, and T-Mobile.
 
We believe in developing great products that are supported by great internal teams and a strong culture.  We are highly committed to and obsessed with the company, users, each other, and our open source community. We have high standards and hold each other accountable for acting with positivity, dedication, thoughtfulness, empathy, and passion daily. 
 
We are deliberate with our decisions with high clarity of intention. At the same time, we feel extreme urgency and move forward quickly. 
 
And lastly, we are highly effective and operationally efficient. We operate collectively as One Team to accomplish our goals.
 
At Sonar, CODE is more than just an acronym – it's a mindset that defines daily operations. 
 
Why You Should Apply: 
 
At Sonar, we’re a group of brilliant, motivated, and driven professionals working hard to help supercharge developers to build better, faster. Sonar helps to continuously improve code quality and code security while reducing developer toil. This means that developers can focus on doing more of what they love and less of what they don’t. Our solutions don’t just solve symptoms of problems – we help fix issues at the source – for all code, whether it's developer-written, AI-generated, or from third parties.
 
We have a dynamic culture with employees worldwide and hub offices in the USA, Switzerland, the UK, Singapore, and Germany. Team members should be able to come to work every day, work on a product they are proud of, love what they do, and feel energized by their peers. With our roots deep in the open source community, we’re all about the mission: supercharge developers to build better, faster.
 
This is a year-long internship role, designed to provide continuous, immersive experience. The commitment will be structured as follows:
 
-Summer Term (Approx. June–August): Full-time, 40 hours per week.
-Academic Year (Approx. September–May): Part-time, 15–20 hours per week, with a flexible schedule arranged to accommodate the student’s class schedule.
 
The Impact You Will Have:
 
Sonar is on the hunt for a highly motivated and sharp college student to join our Purchase-to-Pay team as a Part-Time Hourly Intern for up to 20 hours per week during the academic school year and 40 hours per week over the summer. 
 
This isn't just any internship – it's a prime opportunity to dive deep into financial operations, gain real-world experience, and fast-track your understanding of critical business processes within a rapidly expanding company.

lists.content:
• Processing Vendor Bills with Precision: Become an expert in handling and verifying incoming vendor invoices.
  • Strategic Stakeholder Communication: Collaborate directly with requestors to confirm the receipt of goods or services, ensuring seamless operations.
  • AI deployment:  Come deploy your AI knowledge into real world impact with a fast growing software company 
  • Mastering the Financial Trifecta: Skillfully match vendor bills to corresponding purchase orders and goods received, optimizing our financial flow.
  • Proactive Problem-Solving: Identify and swiftly resolve any discrepancies, keeping our financial records spotless.

• Currently Enrolled and Driven: Pursuing a degree at an accredited college or university.  
  • Tech-Savvy: Proficient in standard computer applications, especially the Microsoft Office Suite – your toolkit for success.
  • Exceptional Communicator: Possess outstanding written and verbal communication skills, crucial for internal and external interactions.
  • Detail-Oriented and Organized: Demonstrate strong organizational skills and an eagle eye for detail, ensuring accuracy in every task.
  • Independent and Collaborative: Thrive both independently and as a valuable team player.
  • An Innovative Thinker: Bring a proactive, problem-solving mindset to the table, ready to tackle challenges head-on.

• Our culture and mission set us apart. We have a dynamic work culture that values respect and kindness and embraces the right to fail (and get right back up again!). 
  • Great people make a great company. We value people skills as much as technical skills and strive to keep things friendly while still being passionate leaders in our domains. 
  • We have a flexible work policy that includes 3 days in-office and 2 days work-from-home each week for those located near our office locations; some locations such as Dubai, India, Japan and Australia operate fully remotely.
  • We have a growth mindset. We love learning and believe continuous education is critical to our success. In an ever-changing industry, new skills are necessary, and we're happy to help our team acquire them.
  • As the leader in our field, our products and services are as strong as our internal team members.
  • We embrace transparency with regular meetings, cascading messages and updates on the growth and success of our organization.

Position description

At Sonar, we are seeking an innovative Research Engineer to join our Data & Agentic team and pioneer the next generation of our code analysis and verification engines. lists.content:
• Create & Innovate: Actively participate in the conceptualization phase. Brainstorm novel ways to improve our products and provide immediate, practical feedback to steer exploratory research toward paths that are both impactful and engineering-feasible.
  • Develop Agentic Workflows: Design, prototype, and validate intelligent agentic systems and automated workflows that facilitate writing clean code, identifying root causes of system issues, and remediating complex bugs and vulnerabilities.
  • Develop Pragmatic Prototypes: Build hands-on prototypes that prove the viability and scalability of research concepts. Proactively identify engineering bottlenecks or scalability limits and propose effective mitigations early in the research phase.
  • Evaluate & Benchmark: Drive the rigorous evaluation of new product features. Construct high-quality datasets, define relevant success metrics, and implement comprehensive benchmarks leveraging Sonar’s existing IP alongside third-party and open-source AI tools.
  • Engineer Data Pipelines: Build and manage robust data pipelines to gather, process, and version massive code-centric datasets required for training and evaluating specialized models at scale.
  • Translate Prototypes to Products: Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to integrate successful prototypes into Sonar's cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet the needs of our global user base.
  • Communicate and Evangelize: Clearly articulate and document complex technical concepts and research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Must have:

  • Advanced academic background in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.

  • Strong software engineering experience (minimum 2+ years in industry) with proficiency in Python and major modern programming languages.

  • Practical experience with modern agentic frameworks, software automation tools, and LLM architectures.

  • Experience of driving research projects from initial ideation to a demonstrable prototype with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party tools, program analysis frameworks, or open-source libraries into functional prototypes.

  • Proven experience in data handling: constructing high-quality datasets, defining objective success metrics, and building robust benchmarks for new solutions.

  • The ability to fast context-switch and maintain momentum across multiple concurrent, fast-moving research topics.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with a talent for translating complex research findings into clear, actionable artifacts for product engineering squads.

    • Plus:

  • Background in static analysis: abstract syntax trees (ASTs), code security, bug detection, etc..

  • Familiarity with LLM techniques such as model fine-tuning, semantic search engines, etc.

  • Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks and cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS). 

    •

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.
Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.
We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow,Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:
SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.
Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:
Committed to our customers and community.
Obsessed with quality.
Deliberate in our decisions.
Effective as one team.
With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

data.additionalPlain:
In-office culture
We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 
Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.
 
We value diversity, equity, and inclusion
At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com. 
All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 
Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

• 5+ years of proven sales leadership experience, including managing managers and/or multiple teams while owning a regional number
  • 5+ years of successful technology software B2B sales experience; ideally in a SaaS or subscription model
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling sales organizations, with a track record of developing front-line leaders
  • Strong strategic and operational planning skills — territory design, resource allocation, and forecasting at a regional level
  • Proven motivational, leadership, and team-building skills, with a passion for growing both reps and managers
  • Strong strategic selling skills — assessing problems, prioritizing sales efforts, and taking focused action; experience with Command of the Message a plus

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, executive presence, and listening skills

lists.content:
You will be a founding leader of the Gitar.ai go-to-market team, responsible for building and running the sales function while personally carrying a quota-bearing book of business. You'll report directly to the CRO, own the team's number, and lead from the front — closing your own strategic deals with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and Heads of Platform Engineering, while building and coaching the AEs around you.


This is a player-coach role inside a category-defining platform. You'll own the team's revenue outcomes end-to-end, while also carrying direct deal responsibility yourself. You'll work closely with the founders of Gitar.ai, the CRO, and the broader Sonar marketing, sales, and customer success teams to stand up go-to-market capabilities from the ground up.

• Own the team's revenue number for standalone AI code review deals, while personally prospecting, closing, and managing a quota-carrying book of strategic accounts

  • Report directly to the CRO on forecast, pipeline health, and go-to-market strategy for the Gitar.ai squad

  • Recruit, hire, and onboard the founding AE team, building sales processes and playbooks from scratch as the squad scales

  • Coach and develop AEs through deal reviews, pipeline inspection, and live deal involvement — stepping in personally on the team's largest or most technically complex opportunities

  • Set territory and account strategy across the team, balancing your own patch with coverage and capacity for the wider group

  • Become a product expert in both Gitar.ai and the broader Sonar portfolio, modeling technical credibility for the team through your own demos and proofs-of-concept

  • Build repeatable go-to-market motion — outbound campaigns, ICP targeting, and pipeline generation — and instill this discipline across the team

  • Maintain rigorous sales process hygiene across the team, leveraging Command of the Message, MEDDPICC, and GTM tooling (Clari, Outreach, Salesforce) to drive forecast accuracy and high-velocity cycles

  • Represent the Gitar.ai squad in leadership and QBR settings, reporting results, risks, and strategy to senior stakeholders

  • Provide direct input to product teams on customer feedback and roadmap priorities, drawing on both your own deals and the team's collective pipeline

The ideal candidate will:


  • Have 7+ years of full-cycle, quota-carrying SaaS sales experience, including 3+ years in a sales leadership role managing individual contributors and owning a team number

  • Demonstrate a proven track record as an individual contributor consistently exceeding quota in a technical B2B sales role, ideally selling to IT, DevOps, platform engineering, or security buyers

  • Have direct experience operating as a genuine player-coach — closing their own deals while simultaneously leading and developing a team

  • Possess strong technical competency to learn Gitar.ai and Sonar's software solutions, engaging credibly with both technical buyers and executive stakeholders; strong familiarity with modern software development (Git, CI/CD, code review workflows, SDLC tooling) required

  • Have experience building sales processes, playbooks, or a team from the ground up in a startup or early-stage GTM environment

  • Be comfortable operating with direct executive exposure, including regular forecast and strategy conversations with a CRO or equivalent

  • Have high levels of customer empathy and a passion for customer success

  • Be energized about working in a startup environment, with a strong work ethic, embrace of ambiguity, and enthusiasm for constant learning

  • Be based in the San Francisco Bay Area and excited to work in person with the team in the San Mateo office

Sonar is looking for a results-driven Sales Manager to lead, coach, and grow a team of Account Executives driving new business and expansion revenue for our AI code verification and governance platform. You'll set your team's sales strategy, own pipeline and revenue growth, and develop reps into top performers, while partnering closely with Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales Operations to keep the sales motion healthy, predictable, and scalable.

lists.content:
• Lead, coach, and motivate a team of Account Executives to consistently meet or exceed quota

  • Own the team's pipeline: forecast accurately on a monthly and quarterly basis, review deals, and identify risks and opportunities early

  • Recruit, onboard, and train new sales talent, building a strong bench for future growth

  • Conduct regular 1:1s, deal reviews, and call/demo coaching sessions to develop rep skills

  • Partner with Sales Operations and Marketing to optimize territory planning, lead flow, and go-to-market execution

  • Analyze team performance metrics (win rate, average deal size, sales cycle length, activity levels) and act on insights

  • Set clear goals and KPIs for each team member and hold the team accountable to them

  • Champion Sonar's CODE values and foster a positive, high-performance team culture

  • Escalate and help resolve customer or deal issues as needed

  • Report on team performance and forecasts to senior sales leadership

The ideal candidate will:

  • Have 10+ years of selling experience, including 5+ years of sales leadership experience

  • Have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets, both individually and as a team leader

  • Bring strong coaching and people-management skills, with experience developing reps at different skill levels

  • Communicate, negotiate, and present with excellence

  • Have experience with sales toolkits (e.g., Salesforce, Clari, Tableau) and sales forecasting/pipeline management

  • Take a data-driven approach to decision-making and performance management, leveraging AI-powered insights to identify trends and optimize team outcomes.

  • Hold a Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

  • Must have experience selling in a B2B SaaS or technology environment

  • Ideally, have experience in free to fee paying motions and upsell driven by customer realisation of value.

  • Be familiar with sales methodologies such as MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, Value Selling, or Command of the Message

  • Demonstrate resilience, adaptability, and the capacity to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic settings

lists.content:
• Lead, coach, and motivate a team of Account Executives to consistently meet or exceed quota

lists.content:
• Help prospective customers understand how our Clean as You Code approach fits within their software development life cycle
  • Drive technical aspects of pre-sales business opportunities by doing technical presentations and demonstrations and supporting product evaluations 
  • Advise customers on the best alignment of the Sonar solution with their favored deployment strategy
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical problems encountered by prospective customers evaluating our products
  • Go beyond the sale to ensure successful product adoption and growth following purchase, working with our Customer Success and Support teams
  • Help existing customers understand the additional capabilities of advanced product editions

  • Excellent English, verbal/written communication skills

lists.text: Why You Will Love It Here:
lists.content:
• Our culture and mission set us apart. We have a dynamic work culture that values respect and kindness and embraces the right to fail (and get right back up again!). 
  • Great people make a great company. We value people skills as much as technical skills and strive to keep things friendly while still being passionate leaders in our domains. 
  • We have a flexible work policy that includes 3 days in-office and 2 days work-from-home each week for those located near our office locations; some locations such as Dubai, India, Japan and Australia operate fully remotely.
  • We have a growth mindset. We love learning and believe continuous education is critical to our success. In an ever-changing industry, new skills are necessary, and we're happy to help our team acquire them.
  • As the leader in our field, our products and services are as strong as our internal team members.
  • We embrace transparency with regular meetings, cascading messages and updates on the growth and success of our organization.

Position description
Our Information Security team's main goal is to build deep trust with our rapidly growing customer base. We do this by ensuring Sonar maintains a top-tier security posture to protect the people who rely on us. We are currently expanding this capability and hiring new members! In this role, you will work hand-in-hand with our CISO and across various teams to shape how we talk to our customers about security, privacy, and compliance and provide accurate and timely information to that audience. Your positive energy and contributions will have a direct impact on our business growth as you embrace Sonar's collective intelligence mindset.

lists.content:
• Customer Interaction & Trust Center Enhancement: You will manage a straightforward process for answering security and technical questions from our customers and internal users. You will also enhance and maintain our Trust Center, making sure it proactively answers customer questions and serves as a go-to resource.

  • Engineering & Security Collaboration: You will collaborate closely with our Engineering, Product, go-to-market and Information Security teams. Together, you will translate complex technical and architectural details into clear, accurate, and friendly responses for our customers.

  • Contract Review & Technical Feedback: You will review customer contracts, MSAs, and DPAs. By partnering with our Legal and Sales teams, you will provide feedback, redlining, and negotiation support on security clauses to ensure everything aligns perfectly with our true capabilities and risk appetite.

  • Trust System Management: You will keep our customer trust systems accurate and support a federated security approach across Sonar. You will also get to drive exciting improvements and add new capabilities to our tooling.

  • AI Prompt Engineering: You will have the opportunity to develop and refine prompts and automated workflows using LLMs, helping us ensure our security information systems stay exceptionally valid and up to date.

• Unwavering Customer Obsession: You truly view security as a way to enable people. You are passionate about building solutions that help teams innovate and move fast without ever compromising the safety of our organization or our users.

  • Contract & Legal Acumen: You have solid experience reviewing, redlining, and providing feedback on security clauses and technical language in customer contracts. You are great at bridging the gap between Legal, Sales, Engineering and InfoSec.

  • Technical Diplomacy & Engineering Collaboration: You are a fantastic communicator! You can partner deeply with Engineering to validate technical details and then turn around and explain those complex security requirements in clear, simple business terms for non-technical peers.

  • Executive Presence: You are comfortable and experienced in working directly with senior leaders, especially a CISO. You know how to effectively communicate strategy, report on trust metrics, and give sound advice on risk.

  • Extensive Multi-Domain InfoSec Expertise: You bring deep experience across several security domains, which might include GRC, Cloud Security, IAM, or Application Security. You are also very familiar with common compliance frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR that our customers care about.

  • AI Proficiency: You have a proven ability to use AI tools and create complex prompts to solve tricky security problems and automate repetitive governance tasks.

  • Autonomous Leadership & Organizational Acumen: You have the strong organizational skills needed to juggle multiple high-stakes projects, audit reviews, and contract negotiations all at once, requiring minimal supervision to achieve broad goals.
This role is based in Austin, TX. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Austin, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

• Flexible comprehensive employee benefit package.
  • We encourage usage of our robust time-off allocations. You will receive 25 days of PTO per calendar year (on a pro-rated basis depending on your employment start date), with additional time provided for sickness, life events and holidays.
  • We offer an exciting 401(k) plan that has a 4% match.
  • Generous discretionary Company Growth Bonus, paid annually.  
  • Fully paid parking in the heart of downtown Austin, Texas.
  • Global workforce with employees in 20+ countries representing 35+ unique nationalities.
  • We have an annual kick-off somewhere in the world where we meet to build relationships and goals for the company.
  • Monthly catered events, and team events.

lists.text: We value diversity, equity, and inclusion
lists.content:
At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com. 

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Position description

As a Senior Associate, Corporate Development at Sonar, you will play a foundational role in shaping the company's growth strategy across M&A, strategic investments, and build/partner/buy decisions. Reporting to the VP, Corporate Development, you will be the primary engine for outbound sourcing, market mapping, and triage of M&A opportunities across the AI coding, developer tools, application security, and broader software development lifecycle (SDLC) ecosystem.

 

You will own day-to-day pipeline management and serve as the connective tissue between Sonar's executive leadership, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal teams as we evaluate M&A opportunities. From first outreach through diligence and integration planning, you will help ensure Sonar evaluates the right opportunities, with the right rigor, at the right pace. This is a high-visibility role designed to give an early-career professional from venture capital, investment banking, or corporate development direct operating exposure at one of the most strategically positioned independent software companies in the AI era.

lists.content:
• Conduct outbound sourcing and market mapping across AI coding, developer tools, application security, and adjacent SDLC categories — building and continuously refreshing landscapes of public and private companies relevant to Sonar's strategy.

  • Triage inbound and outbound opportunities, performing first-pass commercial, product, and technical screens to determine fit, priority, and recommended next steps.

  • Own and maintain Sonar's corporate development pipeline (CRM hygiene, target lists, status tracking, weekly reporting), ensuring leadership has a clear, real-time view of activity and progress.

  • Build and maintain relationships with founders, operators, bankers, venture investors, and other ecosystem participants to generate proprietary deal flow.

  • Engage with internal stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Go-to-Market, Finance, and Legal to gather strategic input, prioritize targets, and align on evaluation criteria.

  • Run structured diligence workstreams on prioritized targets, including analysis of key business metrics (ARR growth, net and gross retention, gross margin, profitability/burn, sales efficiency, customer concentration) and product/technical fit.

  • Build financial models, valuation analyses (comps, precedent transactions, DCF where appropriate), and synthesis materials to support investment decisions and executive review.

  • Prepare crisp, executive-ready memos, dashboards, and board-quality materials that translate complex diligence findings into clear recommendations.

  • Support deal execution by coordinating across internal teams, external advisors, and target-side counterparts on data room reviews, Q&A, and process management.

  • Partner with cross-functional leaders on integration planning and execution for closed transactions, helping translate deal theses into 30/60/90-day operating plans and tracking integration KPIs post-close

  • Contribute to Sonar's broader corporate strategy work, including market sizing, competitive analyses, and "build vs. partner vs. buy" frameworks for new product and category bets.

The ideal candidate will: 

  • 2+ years of full-time experience in venture capital, growth equity, investment banking (TMT/software coverage or M&A), management consulting (with a tech focus), or in-house corporate development at a high-quality technology company.

  • Demonstrated exposure to the full deal lifecycle — sourcing, diligence, modeling, and ideally support on transaction execution and/or post-close integration.

  • Strong financial and analytical fundamentals: comfortable building three-statement and operating models, conducting valuation analyses, and rigorously interrogating SaaS/software business metrics (ARR, NRR/GRR, CAC payback, magic number, Rule of 40, gross margin, FCF).

  • Genuine interest in and curiosity about the developer tools, AI coding, code security, and broader software/DevOps ecosystem; ability to quickly come up to speed on new product categories and technical concepts.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of producing clear, concise, executive-ready memos and presentations.

  • Highly organized, self-directed, and proactive — comfortable owning a pipeline, managing parallel workstreams, and operating with minimal supervision in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence; able to build trust quickly with founders, executives, advisors, and internal stakeholders across functions and geographies.

  • Sound judgment, intellectual honesty, and a high degree of discretion when handling confidential information.

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business, computer science, engineering, or a related field; strong academic record.

lists.content:
HRBP 

  • Act as strategic HRBP for leaders across EMEA (Germany, UK, France, Switzerland) and APAC (Singapore, Japan), advising on org design, workforce planning, performance, and team dynamics with data and a point of view, not just a summary.

  • Use the HRBP people dashboard and org health data to prepare insights for leadership and manager 1:1s, flagging risks and decisions before they become urgent.

  • Support integration and engagement of new EMEA/APAC hires, partnering with Recruiting and People Ops on time-to-productivity and onboarding quality.

  • Translate global People strategy (career frameworks, calibration, internal mobility, compensation philosophy) into guidance that works across EMEA and APAC’s different regulatory and cultural contexts.

    • Employee Relations & Workplace Practices 

  • Own employee relations cases end-to-end across EMEA and APAC. Performance, conduct, grievance, and exit cases — from intake through resolution.

  • Lead workplace investigations with rigor and discretion, producing findings and recommendations that hold up to scrutiny.

  • Partner daily with the Head of Employment Law (Austin) on complex or high-risk cases, ensuring practice stays aligned with employment law across every jurisdiction you cover.

  • Build and maintain the region’s ER case management framework, investigation protocols, and workplace policies, keeping them current as regulation evolves (UK, EU, and APAC employment law; EU AI Act and GDPR implications for People decisions).

  • Train and coach managers on early intervention and proactive feedback, working to reduce ER case volume over time, not just close what lands on your desk.

  • Report on ER metrics, case volume, time-to-close, and risk exposure,  to give leadership a clear, data-backed view of workplace health across the region.

• 7+ years combining HR Business Partner work with employee relations case management or workplace investigations, ideally across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Direct experience partnering with in-house or external employment law counsel on complex, high-stakes cases.

  • Experience supporting EMEA and/or APAC populations, comfortable with the added complexity of multiple legal systems and cultural norms in one remit.

  • Experience in a high-growth technology company where pace is fast and ambiguity is normal.

    • Hard skills

  • Solid grounding in UK and EU employment law fundamentals, with working familiarity with APAC frameworks (or a fast learner’s ability to build it)

  • Proven experience leading formal workplace investigations, from intake and evidence-gathering to written findings.

  • Comfortable with HRIS platforms (BambooHR or equivalent) and building your own data-driven narratives without relying on an analyst.

  • Familiar with, or actively curious about, AI tools in the HR workflow (Glean, Claude, or similar), with the judgment to evaluate outputs critically and own the final call.

    • How you show up

  • Discreet and trusted: people bring you sensitive situations because you handle them with judgment, confidentiality, and consistency.

  • Direct communicator: you bring leaders clear choices and a recommendation, not an escalation without a point of view.

  • Courageous: you hold the line on fairness and doing the right thing, especially when a case is uncomfortable.

  • Structured under pressure: investigations and ER cases don’t wait for a good day, you stay organised and even-handed when things get tense.

This role exists to give that population two things at once: a trusted HRBP who understands the business and the region, and a specialist who owns employee relations with the rigor and consistency a scaling, multi-jurisdiction company needs.

You will carry a dual mandate. As HRBP, you will be the day-to-day partner for leaders across EMEA and APAC, helping them make sound performance decisions and be a trusted partner to the business and its leaders. As the region’s Employee Relations specialist, you will own case management, investigations, and workplace practice end-to-end, working daily alongside our Head of Employment Law (based in Austin) to make sure every case is handled compliantly, consistently, and compassionately.

Your impact will show up in two ways: HRBP outcomes (org health, manager capability, retention) for the leaders you support, and ER outcomes (case volume, time-to-resolution, consistency of practice, and legal risk reduction) across the region.
